_comment: AVIRIS-NG preset, consumed by `apply_oe --lut_config_file` (same flat LUTConfig override as enmap_summer.json).
Matches JPL's v2 corr (ATREM), which assumes a fixed 50 km visibility, i.e. AOT550 of about 0.12
(Thompson et al. 2015). Pinning AOT here took the low-sun Jamnagar flight from 0.0123 to 0.0087 land MAE
against JPL and left the other flights within +-0.0002 (EXPERIMENT_LOG AC26-P).
